description: WSO2 SAP SuccessFactors Job Application Interview provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsRecruiting/overview). The service allows to view and edit job interviews, including their date and time, interviewers and assessments, and to invite candidates to apply for a job requisition.
key-features: Create, update and query job application interviews
Access individual and overall interview assessments
Invite candidates to apply for a job requisition
